experiences.title: Front-End
experiences.subtitle: Application Development

experiences.subtitle: Software Engineering

experiences.subtitle: Camp Sawi 2023

In charge of ensuring participant management and oversight throughout the event, guaranteeing all attendees were present and accounted for. Achieved a successful event execution with a team of 10 in the programs committee.

portfolio.title: Fusevault
portfolio.description: This project was my undergraduate thesis. We built a framework integrating blockchain, IPFS, and MongoDB to solve on-chain storage limitations. I learned about distributed systems architecture and implemented a RESTful API maintaining data integrity through immutable hash storage.

portfolio.title: Noteon
portfolio.description: This was my first experience with Android Studio and Kotlin programming. We were tasked with making an app for our machine project. Decided on an AI note taking app we built using Kotlin and connected Firebase for authentication and Gemini for our AI system.

portfolio.title: Diagnoassist
portfolio.description: This is a pitch for our innovation class and was my introduction to enterprise-level fault-tolerant architecture using Spring Boot microservices, where I implemented database redundancy with Galera Cluster, dynamic failover routing, JWT-based stateless authentication, and ProxySQL load balancing to build a highly available, scalable, and resilient multi-service system.

portfolio.title: Enrollment System
portfolio.description: This was my final project for a Distributed Computing course where we were tasked to make a fault-tolerant enrollment system using Spring Boot microservices. I learned about database redundancy with Galera Cluster, dynamic failover routing, and JWT authentication while implementing automatic load balancing with ProxySQL.

portfolio.title: Media Service
portfolio.description: This was a problem set for a class where we built a concurrent video upload system using Java. I implemented producer-consumer patterns with blocking queues, MD5 hashing for duplicate prevention, and socket-based communication for handling multiple uploads simultaneously.

portfolio.title: HealthKonek
portfolio.description: Me along with a group built a pitch for this AWS project targeting Philippine healthcare accessibility. I designed the cloud architecture using ECS, Lambda, RDS, and IoT Core, created complete user flows and wireframes, and developed a comprehensive business model with cost optimization strategies.

portfolio.title: Time Clock System
portfolio.description: This was my 2nd full stack development experience. This one taught me more about the systematic side of software development for this project we applied SCRUM meetings and communicated with a client for what they need out of our app.

portfolio.title: MyFarm
portfolio.description: This was one of the first few machine projects that I had to make for school. It was a very challenging project since this was my first time working with Java and GUI but I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and am proud of the result.

portfolio.title: Juanderlust
portfolio.description: My first forray into full stack application development. The website was built with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Handlebars, it was also quite a challenging project and I learned a lot because we had to build it from complete scratch.

portfolio.title: Web Portfolio
portfolio.description: This web portfolio is a personal project of mine since I wanted to apply the things I've been learning so far to my life. I thought this would be a good way to measure my capabilities and also find something productive to do with my time.

portfolio.title: Database Development
portfolio.description: This is the starting point of one of my courses for school where we tackled advanced databases. The class was my first introduction to many advanced data science topics some of my favorite learnings were ETL Tools and OLAP Functions.
